subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept announceLastRun plus non-running "killed" reconciliation as the canonical restart behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes persisted session lifecycle semantics and the internal tool boundary for inter-session announce delivery, which are compatibility and safety choices for maintainers.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

options.title: Adjust recovery state first
options.body: Change the reconciliation status or naming before merge while preserving the announce-vs-human turn distinction.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery model
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want announce, lock, and delivery recovery solved through a wider session-delivery redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history ties this owner most directly to restart recovery lifecycle seams and Codex tool registration paths affected by the decision.
